description: For each constant \(c\), its congruence clause is exactly \(\{E(c,c)\}\); for each zero-ary old relation \(R\), its clause is exactly \(\{\neg R(),R()\}\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.zero_arity_clauses.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language} (c : L.Functions 0)
  (R : L.Relations 0) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.functionClause c =
      {Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.positive
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.eqAtom (FirstOrder.Language.func c Fin.elim0)
            (FirstOrder.Language.func c Fin.elim0))} ∧
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.relationClause R =
      {Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.negative
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.oldAtom R Fin.elim0),
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.positive
          (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.oldAtom R Fin.elim0)}
